concerns.text: User Story 1 (Dataset Acquisition and Preparation, P1) has no success criterion. SC-001 through SC-005 all trace to FR-005/FR-003/FR-008 (US-2/US-3). The foundational P1 story is backed only by FR-001; add an SC measuring dataset acquisition (e.g., number of valid paired problem entries measured against the FR-001 minimum, or pair-integrity rate against the no-partial-data rule in US-1 scenario 2).
